title: Write your probation self-assessment
why_matters: The self-assessment is the artefact your manager reads first. Three paragraphs — delivered, learned, want next — and a page that fits on one screen. Most BAs write four pages of adjectives. Don't. The discipline of compression is what shows judgement.
steps: Open the probation-pack playbook. Look at the worked example — that's the length and tone to aim for.
Write the Delivered paragraph first. Be specific; name actual deliverables with the receipts attached. No adjectives where verbs would do.
Write the Learned paragraph. Include something you misjudged. Show what changed.
Write the Want-next paragraph. End with one specific thing you want from your manager to make the next 90 days possible.
success_criteria: A one-page self-assessment exists in the probation-pack format. Three paragraphs, no longer. Manager has not yet seen it (it goes to them in mission 2).
reflection_prompt: Which of the three paragraphs was hardest to write honestly, and why?
